pin_notes.aee_engine: Engine 1.5.0, cut from engine main c0d80947989eb874d29521816004b5e2487cdd5c (the Spec 004 joint-phase merge; that tree reports version 1.5.0, verified locally against the commit before this bump). Pin bumped 2026-10-12 together with the fixture stage migration (docs/protocol.md, 'Engine 1.5.0 fixture migration, 2026-10-12'): claim bundles the runner strict-loads now carry an explicit stage. Extension and evaluator pins are unchanged; their bumps ride their own releases.
pin_notes.aee_extension: Vendored from spec-kit-aee release v1.4.0 (tag commit d7d7ce4; extension version 1.4.0, 10 commands, engine floor >=1.5.0,<2). The 1.4.0 manifest declares the spec-kit-evaluator extension a required companion and the runner's assess enforces it (exit 2 when .specify/extensions/evaluator/ is absent from the project), so the benchmark vendors the pair together and the workflow installs the pair into assessment sandboxes. The vendored claims template still carries no stage field; the 1.4.0 runner loads pre-stage-vocabulary bundles through the engine's --lenient path, which defaults stage to created on the record (assessment metadata carries loading_mode and stage_defaults).
pin_notes.archives: Archive sha256 values are the digests of the release tag archives downloaded from GitHub on 2026-10-12 for the extension re-vendor, computed locally from the downloaded bytes. The binding pins are the tag commits above plus the vendored tree digests in vendored_sha256, enforced by scripts/check_pins.py in CI.
pin_notes.evaluator_extension: Vendored from spec-kit-evaluator release v1.1.0 (tag commit 8c7e6bb; extension version 1.1.0; FR-6 composition contract, the FR-7 reference evaluator, and Spec 004 P5 lane-paired composition in all three composers). Required companion of the vendored AEE extension 1.4.0: the pair is one system.
